title: Stillfront新任CEO为前EA、King和Embark高管Marcus Jacobs
content:
Stillfront’s new boss is former EA, King and Embark exec Marcus Jacobs – Mobilegamer.biz
Skip to content
Stillfront has confirmed that Marcus Jacobs will succeed Alexis Bonte as president and group CEO.
The Swedish roll-up firm owns the studios behind mobile game series including Supremacy, Empire, BitLife and Albion Online. It also reported its Q3 results today, which saw a 1% drop in revenue and profits down 16%.
Stillfront’s new president and group CEO Marcus Jacobs brings over 25 years of experience in the games business, and succeeds Alexis Bonte on November 1.
Jacobs was director of monetization at EA before joining King for a seven year stint in 2012. He was also chief commercial officer of Embark Studios from 2020 to 2022 and was appointed a member of Stillfront’s board in 2022. He’ll be based in Stockholm.
Stillfront’s profits, as per its Q326 financials.
Stillfront’s financials for Q3 2026 saw the firm pull in SEK 1,291m in net revenue, or around $130m. That’s down 1% year-on-year. Profits as measured by Adjusted EBITDAC were SEK 366m, or $36.8m, a 16% yer-on-year drop.
Outgoing CEO Alexis Bonte blamed the declines on deprioritised catalogue games. “Key franchises grew organically for the fifth consecutive quarter, and strong profitability remained a core feature of our business, he added. “The performance was led by Big, Empire and Board, reflecting the contribution from new game launches, strong LiveOps execution and improved player monetisation.”
